messages.content: Which planet has rings around it with a name starting with letter S?

message.content:
The planet you’re thinking of is **Saturn**.  

Saturn is famous for its spectacular system of rings, which are made up of countless icy particles ranging from tiny grains to large boulders. It’s the only planet whose name begins with the letter “S” and also has such a prominent ring system. (While other planets—Jupiter, Uranus, and Neptune—also have rings, their names do not start with “S.”)
